messages:
arjun: quick sync after the postmortem 3: owners + timelines for the SLO changes and recurrence detection? we still see the KVCache stall pattern.

mel: i'll own the SLO proposal and governance ticket. drafting measurement queries now. aiming to have the request in 36h.

sophie: i'll own dashboards/alerts. will add per-route p50/p95/p99, burn-rate, and an alert that fires if the same root_cause tag appears 3x in 90d. ETA 48h.

arjun: infra side: i'll prototype adaptive throttling (queue-length + kv-hit fallback). target: staging repro today, design doc + PR in 4 business days.

mel: decision on error budget reset? i'm leaning no. we should let the burn signal urgency. anyone object?

sophie: agree no reset. dash will show ongoing burn and a link to postmortem.

arjun: propose scoped SLO for long-context requests: p95=250ms (current default 150ms). mel: will include that in the SLO-change ticket and tag product for sign-off.

infra-bot: Reminder set for 2026-03-26 10:00 UTC to review owners (mel, sophie, arjun).

mel: opened SLO ticket SLO-2026-177 with queries + rationale. requested governance sign-off by EOD tomorrow.

sophie: dash ticket D-8110 created. added "jump to traces" and runbook link. recurrence alert rule added.

arjun: posted staging repro steps and trace links in the staging channel. PR-4999 (draft) for throttle.

arjun: summary: mel (SLO ticket) - 36h, sophie (dash+alerts) - 48h, arjun (throttle PR) - 4bd. no error budget reset. schedule 2-week follow-up to validate recurrence suppression.

mel: sounds good. closing here, will update tickets as work progresses. thanks :thumbsup:
